name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio: Bjørn grew up in a small coastal town in Norway, where he developed a fascination with cars and boats. He spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning about different types of paints and finishes. After completing a vocational program in automotive painting, he moved to the UK to pursue his passion for motorsport. He started as an apprentice at a local garage before landing a job at Tickford Racing. Bjørn takes immense pride in his work, seeing the paint job as the final touch that transforms a machine into a work of art. His meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to perfection have earned him the respect of his colleagues.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Bjørn is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always uses a specific brand of microfiber cloth.
Has a habit of whistling while working.
Insists on cleaning his spray gun immediately after each use.
